book.name: 1 Kolinita
book.title: 1 KOLINITA MeKolinita ꞌidi leta ꞌaigeda Paulo ꞌileleya

content: Yehoba ꞌina topaihowao

Ma tasigwao, geya sowasowahina ma sanapu moisa yahehepwaile ꞌoimiya, weyahina yaluyaluwami geya simatuha, ta ꞌimi nuwatuhu ꞌabwa tuwa gogo gabulena ꞌidi nuwatuhu gidemusa. Weyahina ꞌomi wahegaina tuwa Keliso ꞌana hemisa ꞌoina, gide sedaseda ꞌiꞌiudi.
Coinega geya sowasowahimi ma ꞌeꞌahai yaꞌebwaegomi ma hesi susumo ꞌoinega yaheꞌaigomiya, weyahina mwalona ma nige geya sowasowahina ꞌeꞌahai waꞌai.
Moisa, mumugami ꞌabwa tuwa gogo gabulena gidemusa, weyahina ꞌabwa waheꞌoheꞌohe ma waheꞌipiꞌipi tuwa.
Ta tupwami wagwae, “Tauma Paulo ꞌina boda.” Ta tupwami wete wagwae, “Tauma Apolosa ꞌina boda.” Cimi gwaeyedi gidemusa gogo gabulena ꞌidi gwae.

Togidega taugu ma Apolosa weyahima waheheꞌoheꞌohe? Tauma topaihowa tuwa, ꞌida Bada weyahina. Cida Badaina ꞌima paihowa ꞌiꞌebwaemaiya hagadi ma hagadi ꞌapaipaihowadi, ma ꞌoinega ꞌomi Keliso wahemisaeya.
Taugu ꞌigu paihowa todauna tuwa, ma Apolosa toꞌitayahi. Ma Yehoba hesi ꞌiboimo ꞌina waiwaiyega ꞌeꞌahai ꞌiyada.
Coinega Yehoba ꞌiboimo tahepwatuwe, ma tauma sahena. Weyahina tauma todauna ma toꞌitayahina.
Ma hesi ꞌabwa tauma tanoha ꞌana topaihowao ꞌama maisa ꞌaigeda ꞌaigeda ꞌada loba gidemusa ꞌima hetapewa ꞌana madou.
Bewa tuwa Yehoba baꞌidamai ꞌina tanoha ꞌapaipaihowa, ta ꞌina tanohina beno ꞌomi tomota tuwa. Ma wete ꞌomi Yehoba ꞌina hada.

Weyahina Yehobaina ꞌihelauwegauwa ma ꞌihesumanegauwa ma ꞌabehega ꞌina toꞌabi hada, ꞌoinega ꞌohola yalagu bwaibwainidiya ma ꞌoinega tupwadi topaihowa ꞌoholaedi ꞌoidiya ma siꞌabi, ꞌilobwainediya ma sida ꞌabi bwaibwaina.
Cida ꞌoholaina ꞌimiyamiya, tauna Yesu Keliso, ꞌoinega geya sowasowahina ma hali ꞌohola tahetoholo.

Ma hesi ꞌoholaina tabwanina ꞌida yowayowana talagudi. Tupwadi tomota ꞌidi yowayowana bwebweꞌadi siꞌewedima, gidemusa ꞌulabwa nuwana sagumo nuwana kasikasi, ma tupwadi ꞌidi yowayowanedi weꞌadi siꞌeweꞌewedima, gidemusa keipoki bo ꞌaulaha bo mulumulu.
Coinega ꞌabwa bwaꞌomatana ꞌana sabwelo ꞌoina ꞌida Badaina hadaedi ꞌihadadadi ma ꞌida tohodi, nuwana bwebweꞌadi bo galadi.
Taudi siꞌabi bwaibwaina ꞌadi maisa siꞌewa.
Ma taudi ꞌidi ꞌabi galadi, ꞌidi hadaedi ꞌigabu yahuledi ma loheloheyamo ꞌiꞌabihetedi, ma gesowana ꞌeta wete ꞌidi tobwatobwa ꞌitupwatupwa.
Eema wanuwatuhuyahi ꞌabehega tauda Yehoba ꞌina Hada Heꞌasisi, weyahina Yehoba Yaluyaluwana ꞌoida ꞌimiyamiya.
Ceguma taiyawedi Yehoba ꞌina hadaina siꞌabihegaleya, Yehoba wete ꞌida ꞌabihegaladi. Weyahina ꞌina hadaina ꞌasiꞌasilalana ma taudi siꞌabi hegaleya. Cina hadaina tauda.

Gesowana taiya ꞌowa ꞌuboi ꞌuꞌabowego ꞌabehega ꞌowa ꞌaigeda tosanapu, weyahina ꞌeguma baleꞌu bewa ꞌana sanapumo ꞌusanapuya, ꞌilobwainegowa ma sanapuina ꞌulogwahate ma ꞌoinega sanapu moisa Yehoba ꞌoinega ꞌuloba.
Weyahina sanapu bewa baleꞌuwa gide yauyaule Yehoba matana. Weyahina Buki Heꞌasisi ꞌoina ꞌihepwaila gidemusa ꞌigwaeya,

content.text: “Yehoba tosanapuwao ꞌiꞌonediya ma sida hesilae siboi ꞌidi gomanega.”

content: Ma wete ꞌigwaeya,
Ma sahena wagwaegwae hanehane ꞌimi tohanugetaowedi baleꞌuwa weyahidi, weyahina Keliso ginaula mabwaiyadi ꞌiꞌebwae pwaigomiya.

Gidemusa taugu ma Apolosa ma Pita wete ꞌilagumaiya ꞌami toꞌabihetenao, ma baleꞌu wete mabwaiyana ꞌiꞌebwaegomiya, ma wete yawasimi ta ꞌimi ꞌamasa, wete ginaula mabwaiyana tuta bewa ꞌoina ma tuta sinaonaoma ꞌoidiya ꞌiꞌebwaegomiya.
Weyahina ꞌomi Keliso ꞌina tomotaiyao, ta Kelisoina Yehoba ꞌoinega.
